page.layout: One printed page, framed by a decorative border; text in one block, centred. No margin notes. Below the text a small ornament.

main_text.head: PRÆFATIO
main_text.p: Heliâ artium in lucem deniq; producto. Precamur autem Patrem luminum, ut ipse hûc benedictionē suam elargiri dignetur, ut ad ejus gloriam hæc inprimis vertant, & Ecclesiæ emolumento sint, præsertim instantis calamitatis ærumnoso tempore. Perscripsi 4. Apr. anno 1612.
main_text.head: PROTESTATIO.

p.i: Quæ de Universali Regni Mineralis universalissimo in hac Cheiragogia asserimus, nihil derogare volumus Canonibus nostris Hermeticis sive Helianis Aphorismis, quibus Ens Medium majoris & minoris mundi pertractavimus, ex quo homini constat sanitas. Dixi.

page.notes: The ornament below the last line is a printer's device and is not transcribed. Abbreviations and spelling are as printed; the italic passages are set in italic type. The text is in the original printed as "Heliâ", "deniq;", "benedictionē" and similar forms, kept as printed.
